headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for **Warmup Wi-Fi underfloor-heating thermostats** — 4iE, 6iE, 7iE Smart Matter, Element Wi-Fi, Terra Wi-Fi, and rebadged OEM units. Maintained fork of `homebridge-warmup4ie`.
footerDisplay: Need help? See the [README](https://github.com/nookied/homebridge-warmup4ie-v2#readme) or [open an issue](https://github.com/nookied/homebridge-warmup4ie-v2/issues).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown in Homebridge logs.

refresh.title: Polling interval (seconds)
refresh.description: How often to fetch room status from the Warmup cloud. Lower values = more responsive, more API load. Warmup may throttle accounts that poll faster than 30s.

duration.title: Override duration (minutes)
duration.description: How long a manual temperature change stays active before the schedule resumes. Maximum 1440 (24 h).
